name: gemini-listen-downloader
description: Chrome extension to download, convert to MP3 and trim Gemini's "Listen" audio, plus a Claude Code skill that turns work summaries into Tamil voice-note prompts for Gemini.

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('extension')) if (f.endsWith('.js')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'extension/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
